scope: Manual review of the actual post-change student-visible behavior and retained raw outputs. Parent release approval is still required.

findings.closure: The exact original .62 English question again generates the unsupported measured-gradient sentence. The runtime rejects it and returns only labelled reviewed guidance, with IsModelAnswer=false and GeneratedText=null. Raw output is preserved in evaluation diagnostics.

Combined temperature/flow questions route before model loading to the complete reviewed temperature and convection modules, with both sets of citations and an explicit no-convection-correction boundary. No missing LLM explanation is claimed.

The first post-change .83 Spanish answer correctly states .6889 but incorrectly attributes quadratic scaling to the gradient. Its original automatic-pass report and raw generation are preserved. A scoped subject-contradiction guard now rejects the identical repeated generation and returns labelled reviewed guidance.

actualAcceptedAnswersReviewed: Spanish .62: b_scale=.3844, linear q and quadratic b, whole waveform and fixed times, synthetic non-calibration boundary.
English .71: b_scale=.5041 with the same physical conditions and explicit non-calibration boundary.
retainedLimitations: These conservative lexical guards address the observed typed synthetic b-scale failure classes. They are not a proof that arbitrary prose is correct and may choose documentary guidance for ambiguous language.
Two native generations were rejected. They are not reported as successful generated answers.

The original 103 checks were executed before these source changes. The new reports explicitly separate guard fixtures, captured replay, actual documentary routing and actual new generation; unaffected historical tests are not relabelled as rerun.
No system instructions, model weights, original training reports, course or derivations were modified by these runtime corrections.
